finance_sql.party_join: Join on subsidiaryId, NOT customer_id (NULL on 5,263 of 6,845 posted invoices) and NOT subsidiaryCode (4,950 rows carry a legacy code; 226 distinct values do not exist in Customer at all). Nama's REST resolves subsidiary.code to the CURRENT code — measured on SV00001: SQL holds C00002, REST returns C2000001 — so the live path is immune to this.
finance_sql.drift_guard: app/integrations/finance/guard.py re-reconciles ONE CLOSED month against SQL after every sweep. What is invariant for a closed month is the document SET and each document's gross and net; paid legitimately grows (a May invoice settles in July), so growth is explained, not drift. Catches: a renamed Nama field (net reads short), a narrowed credential (documents vanish), a posting-convention change (extra documents). freshness.guard carries {status, reason, period, checked_at} on every finance response; full per-document detail at GET /api/v1/finance/live; on-demand POST /api/v1/finance/live/guard. `drift` reverts the DEFAULT to sql and says so, while an explicit ?source=live still works. `unknown` never diverts — being unable to check is not evidence of a wrong figure. Settings: FINANCE_GUARD_ENABLED, FINANCE_GUARD_PERIOD (blank = two months back), FINANCE_ALLOWED_REVERSALS (default FP22026060000105).
finance_sql.shared_core: app/integrations/finance/reconcile.py holds the comparison; scripts/reconcile_live_vs_sql.py and guard.py both call it, so the release gate and the production watchdog cannot disagree about what counts as a difference.

nama_400_semantics.finding: Nama answers HTTP 400 for TWO different things and the client conflated them.
nama_400_semantics.empty_400: a valid filter matching zero rows -> empty body -> 'no match' (find_first).
nama_400_semantics.partial_400: SOME records failed to serialise; the successful ones ARE in the body. This was being raised as an error, which is why ReceiptVoucher and PaymentVoucher looked unreadable. Now kept and tagged `_partial` so a sum built from an incomplete set can never look like a true total.
traps_for_any_live_aggregate: records_count is PER PAGE, not a total - it counts only rows serialised in that response
'@draft' suffix on a document code = UNPOSTED draft; must be filtered or drafts get summed with posted documents

'@draft' is not the only unposted marker: one PurchaseInvoice is Draft with NO code at all. is_draft() now also treats a missing/blank code as unposted — safe, since zero of the 13,686 posted invoice rows has an empty code.
nama_400_semantics.open_question: ANSWERED: yes. Rebuilt net/paid matched SQL to the piastre on live documents, and the reconciliation is now a repeatable script (scripts/reconcile_live_vs_sql.py, exit 1 on any unexplained difference) rather than a one-off check.

nama_expert.what: Owner's request 2026-07-25: an AI expert chat that solves problems — ask it about Nama or the platform, upload a screenshot of an error, talk to it by voice. Backlog A4-A9.
nama_expert.index: ~3,300 chunks from two things that already existed: the repo's markdown (same allow-list /tools/library serves) and the gateway's own map (registry.SYSTEMS, catalog.CONNECTORS, catalog.ENDPOINTS, ideas). NOTHING is hand-copied into the expert's code — a rule changes in the runbook and the answer changes with it.
nama_expert.retrieval: BM25, offline, no embedding service: no third credential, works with nothing configured, and reproducible from the repo alone. Arabic normalisation folds alef/ya/ta-marbuta and strips tashkeel+tatweel.
three_arabic_fixes_each_a_real_bug: mark ranges written as \uXXXX escapes — Arabic letters U+0621-U+064A sit BETWEEN two blocks of diacritics, and a range one codepoint too wide deletes the alphabet: every document tokenises to nothing and every question returns nothing, with no error. Locked by a test.

question scaffolding (ليه/إزاي/فين) stripped from the QUERY — in a formal corpus the colloquial 'ليه' is as rare as 'pageSize', so IDF rated them equally and a chunk matching only 'ليه...نما' beat the one chunk explaining the truncation. Rarity is not aboutness.
score scaled by rarity-weighted coverage — plain BM25 sums per-term scores, so three common words can beat the single rare word the question is about.
max 3 passages per section — a customer-balances question came back as six consecutive rows of one table, so the model never saw the endpoint that serves them.
nama_expert.two_modes: grounded (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set) = composed answer with [S#] citations. sources_only (no key, model down, or no network) = the passages themselves with their sources, and it says no model is attached. The second is not a sad degradation: it is the project rule applied to prose — old is bad, wrong is far worse. An answer that cites nothing is FLAGGED in its own note rather than passed off.
nama_expert.governing_rule: Every answer names its source — endpoint, document or entity — and 'I do not know' is a valid answer. A confident wrong answer about a Nama write rule destroys records: addRecord:true replaces silently, re-saving a draft commits it permanently.
nama_expert.security: Key server-side only. The page gets the gateway key like any /tools/* page and calls /api/v1/expert/ask; a test asserts the page contains no fetch to any external host. Voice is the browser's own Web Speech API (ar-EG) — zero vendor, zero key. Screenshots travel through the gateway, not from the browser to the model.
nama_expert.on_the_map: System `ai` is now LIVE with url /tools/expert. New connector `expert` (live with no credential — the index is local). `ai-layer` stays NOT live: the orchestrator that would ACT across connectors is unbuilt; the expert only reads and cites. legal_counsel.status: BUILT 2026-07-25. app/integrations/legal/{corpus,manifest,citations,templates,router}.py + modules/legal/counsel.html. Page /tools/legal, API /api/v1/legal/{'',coverage,search,law/{slug},templates,ask,draft,review,verify,reindex}. 33 tests. Design note: docs/legal-counsel.md.
legal_counsel.what: Owner's request 2026-07-25: a smart-lawyer chatbot sourced from constitutions and Egyptian/international law (especially Chinese, commercial, civil, civil-service, labour, criminal) that writes contracts, reviews bylaws and checks drafts. Backlog L2-L10.
legal_counsel.the_whole_point: Article numbers. A model produces them as fluently as any other token, and «المادة 147 من القانون المدني» is four words a non-lawyer cannot check and has every reason to trust — a wrong one voids a clause or loses a case. So the module does not ask the model to behave; citations.py CHECKS. confirmed (in a loaded statute) passes; unverifiable (law not loaded) is marked, neither confirmed nor denied; fabricated (law IS loaded, article is NOT in it — the only verdict with no innocent reading) is struck out. Redaction happens in the body of the sentence, not a footnote: a legal answer gets copied into an email and the qualification at the bottom does not travel with it. answer_raw keeps the original for audit.
legal_counsel.tiers: statute = authority, the only tier an article is confirmed against. precedent = our own signed contracts, which prove what we agreed and never what the law says. internal = our 18 bylaws, binding on us only — and zero are certified by the directorate (from REP), so the penalties bylaw is not in force at all. The separation is enforced in code because the two collapse into each other in the mind of anyone reading at speed, including the model.
legal_counsel.empty_corpus_is_designed: manifest.py lists 24 expected sources; each is loaded or NAMED AS MISSING. «مالقيتش حاجة» is useless; «ده محكوم بقانون العمل ونصّه مش عندي — حمّله وأنا أجاوب بالمادة» is useful on day one. Deliberately absent from the manifest: law numbers and years — those get read out of a loaded text. Typing them from memory would be the same act deleted from the finance pages, in the domain where wrong costs most.
legal_counsel.four_modes: ask (needs a model for prose) · draft (6 templates, NO model needed) · review · verify (NO model, NO network). /verify is the cleanest part: same answer every time, works unconfigured, and works on text we did not write — the other side's draft, an old contract, a clause sent on WhatsApp.
legal_counsel.templates_cite_no_article: A template is not model output, so it would sail past the guard — the one remaining path by which an invented article could reach a SIGNED document. A test renders every template with every clause and fails on a single article reference. Templates name the governing law (safe, checkable) and warn where a statutory limit belongs: «الشرط المخالف باطل ولو وقّع عليه العامل». Unfilled blanks stay visible as ⟨label⟩.
legal_counsel.corpus_dir: corpus/legal/ — .txt or .md with a 4-line front matter (slug/title/tier/jurisdiction), articles headed «مادة 12» or «المادة (12)» or «المادة ١٢ مكرر». Arabic-Indic digits accepted: scanned Egyptian statutes are typeset with them. Then POST /api/v1/legal/reindex.
legal_counsel.boundary: Not a lawyer and not a substitute for one — every answer and every draft closes with that line, and so does the page. Read-only. Key server-side; a test asserts the page has no fetch to any external host.
